mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_import_export_template (id, template_name, template_type, module_code, version, file_id, is_default, default_scope_key, status) VALUES (#{template.id}, #{template.templateName}, #{template.templateType}, #{template.moduleCode}, #{template.version}, #{template.fileId}, #{template.defaultTemplate}, #{template.defaultScopeKey}, #{template.status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_import_export_template SET is_default = 0, default_scope_key = CONCAT('ID:', id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE module_code = #{moduleCode} AND template_type = #{templateType} AND is_default = 1
UPDATE sys_import_export_template SET is_default = 1, default_scope_key = 'DEFAULT', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ENABLED'
UPDATE sys_import_export_template SET status = 'DISABLED', is_default = 0, default_scope_key = CONCAT('ID:', id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ENABLED'
